_comment: PRODUCT PROFILE template. The entry point for one product, shared across every practice. Binds the product to the systems, repositories, and reference sources it uses, and layers product-specific meaning on top of those shared records. Declared by the product area's AGENTS.md via 'Context Fabric profile: product:<slug>'. Save to records/profiles/<slug>.json. Remove all _comment fields before saving — and set contentLocations[0].path to this record's own path.
name: {{Product name}}
description: {{What the product is, in one or two sentences.}}

systems.useWhen: {{the trigger that makes this system relevant to a task}}

anchors._comment: An exact, validated home inside the system: a tracker project key, a wiki page ID, a folder. Anchors are what stop an agent from searching a whole system.

repositories.useWhen: {{the trigger that makes this repo relevant to a task}}
pathScope: {{optional glob narrowing to the parts this product owns}}

referenceResources.useWhen: {{what class of question sends a reader to this source}}
referenceResources.relianceCheck: {{how the reader confirms an artifact there is still safe to rely on}}

taskGuidance.notes: {{Where outputs for this product go, and any product-specific routing.}}
